(pa)༄༅/ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rje btsun ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal ba'i yum gcig 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// phrin las sna tshogs rdzogs par sgrub byed pa'i// sgrol ma nyer gcig rjes gnang cho ga bri// na ma āryā tā rā yai/ bla ma rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ jo bo chen po bod du byon khar rdo rje gdan du bskor bar mdzad cing*/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun mas mngon sum du khyod bod la byon cig dang*/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs rgya chen po 'ong bar yod/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bstod pa 'di la brten pa'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sgrub pa'i tshul 'di la thugs dam mdzod/ bar chad mi 'byung zhing mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub bo// zhes rje btsun mas dngos su gnang ba ste bod du phebs nas thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad cing*/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs slob ma rnams la gnang nas rim par brgyud pa yin no// 'di nyid sgrub cing nyams su len pa la rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa thob pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rje btsun ma'i sku gzugs sogs rten gsum dgram/ mchod gtor sogs legs par bsham/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen sogs dang*/ byams pa nas brgyud brgyud pa rin po che// jo bo yab sras yon tan rin po che// sku mched la sogs bka' brgyud rin po che// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes sogs bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis kyang phyag bya/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gu ru āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa phul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong len pa byung na legs/ de nas byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ lha rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byon nas rang rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du song bar mos/ tshogs zhing rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa ni sngon 'gro bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa'o// de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid du mos pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod cing sngags don yid la bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla re me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su seng ldeng nags kyi tshal lta bu'i sa gzhi la rin po che'i phye ma gdal ba/ ljon shing sna tshogs me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa/ sdong po chen po chu ba dmar po/ lo 'dab sngon po rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'dab ma can/ gser gyi ze ba sbur long gi ze'u 'bru dang ldan pa/ snying po thog la dngul gyi ri mos bskor ba/ dpag tshad du ma'i khyon can gyi lte ba dang*/ mtha' skor du sna tshogs padma'i gdan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng du zla ba'i gdan bcu drug

nyi ma'i gdan lnga rnams su gyur par bsgom/ lha bskyed tshul la cho ga gsum bskyed byas na'ang rung mod kyang rgya gzhung las skad cig dran rdzogs su mdzad pas de'i tshul ni/ dbus su rang nyid seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon pa'i phyag rgyas utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba bsnams pa/ bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal dang ldan zhing*/ nu 'bur rgyas pa zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra mthon mthing phyed bcings su byas shing*/ lhag ma bsil bur babs pas sku stod khebs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing pañtsa li ka'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs byas pa/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de bzhin du gdan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng du las bzhi sgrub pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgom pa ni/ ༈ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis bgegs dang log 'dren zhi zhing dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ shar nas g.yas skor gyis gdan dang por myur zhing dpa' ba'i rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mthil na dbang du sdud pa'i bum pa dmar po bsnams pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpa la bsnams shing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ pad zla'i gdan la sems ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ ༈ /nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi bar 'dod na/ gdan gnyis pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma zhi ba chen mo ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na zhi bar byed pa'i bum pa dkar po bsnams pa/

lhag ma gong bzhin te 'og ma kun la'ang shes par bya'o/ ༈ /yang tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par 'dod na/ gdan gsum pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma gser mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rgyas pa'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ ༈ /tshe rgyas par 'dod na/ gdan bzhi pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma gser mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na tshe rgyas pa'i bum pa ser po bsnams pa/ ༈ /rig ma sogs dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ gdan lnga pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma hūm̐ sgra sgrogs ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na yid 'phrog pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /'byung po 'dul bar 'dod na/ gdan drug pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dmar nag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na 'byung po myos par byed pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /gzhan gyi rig sngags zlog par 'dod na/ gdan bdun pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma gzhan gyi mthu 'joms ma sku mdog nag mo cung zad khro ba g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rig sngags zlog par byed pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /bdud dang dgra gnyis 'joms par 'dod na/ gdan brgyad pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma bdud dgra 'joms ma sku mdog dmar nag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na dgra 'joms pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /'jigs pa skyob par 'dod na/ gdan dgu pa la rje btsun ma dkon mchog gsum mtshon sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na 'jigs pa skyob pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /'jig rten dbang du bsdu bar 'dod na/ gdan bcu pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma bdud 'joms shing 'jig rten dbang du sdud ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag mthil na bdud 'joms shing dbang du sdud pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /dbul ba sel bar 'dod na/

gdan bcu gcig pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ma sku mdog gser btso ma ltar dmar ser du 'dug pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na phongs pa skyob pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /bkra shis par 'dod na/ gdan bcu gnyis pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma bkra shis par mdzad ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bkra shis par mdzad pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /dgra'i dpung 'joms par 'dod na/ gdan bcu gsum pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma me ltar 'bar ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na dgra 'joms pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /bgegs la bsnun par 'dod na/ gdan bcu bzhi pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma khro gnyer can sku mdog nag mo khro gnyer cung zad tsam yod pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyis bgegs la bsnun pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na/ gdan bco lnga pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma zhi ba chen mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na sdig pa zhi bar byed pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /shes rab 'phel zhing rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'dod na/ gdan bcu drug pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rig sngags 'phel bar byed pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /bdud dang bar chad gnon par 'dod na/ gdan bcu bdun pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'jig rten g.yo ba sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rig sngags gnon pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /klu'i tshogs kyi dug zhi bar 'dod na/ gdan bco brgyad pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma dug nad zhi zhing sel bar byed ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na dug nad sel bar byed pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /rtsod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa sel bar 'dod na/ gdan bcu dgu pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/

༈ /rims nad srung bar 'dod na/ gdan nyi shu pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma rims nad sel ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rims nad sel ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ༈ /rnal 'byor pas phrin las sna tshogs sgrub par 'dod na/ gdan nyer gcig pa la skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas utpa la bsnams pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ pad zla'i gdan la sems ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsgom/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha rang rang gi mdog can gyi tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang rang rang so so'i dam tshig pa rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drang*/ mchod/ 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma thams cad dag bde ba chen po myong ngo*// chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med re res rgyas gdab cing dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs nas yan lag bdun pa'i bar dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod par bya'o// de nas lha rnams la dmigs pa'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/

nga rgyal brtan pa dang*/ de'ang rnam pa lhar gsal ba dang*/ ngo bo rang bzhin med par nges pa'i zab gsal gnyis med la bslab bo// sgom pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la lha rang rang gi mdog can gyi tām̐ yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar phye nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sgrub pa'i dmigs pa so sor gsal bar bya zhing*/ lha de dang de la nga rgyal bzhag nas bzlas pa bya'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ gtso mo la gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa 'di kho na'o// gzhan lha mo nyer gcig la ni swā hā'i gong du spel tshig sbyar bas bzla dgos pas 'di ltar/ dang po la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā/

dbang du mdzod/ ces so/ /de bzhin du/ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhi bar mdzod/ ces so/ /puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas par mdzod/ ces so/ /ā yurdzñā na hrīḥbhrūm̐ swā hā/ tshe dang ye shes stsol/ ces so/ /che ge mo ā karṣa ya hrīḥ rig ma sogs khug ces so/ /sarba duṣṭiṃ tshu lu swā hā/ gdug pa thams cad myos su chug ces so/ /rbad 'dre rbod gtong sarba wa ra ṇa ye bhyaḥswā hā/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad zlog ces so/ /bdun tshan dang po'o// a mu ka sha tū mā ra ya phaṭa/ bdud dang dgra bo che ge mo khos/ zhes pa'o/ /gnod pa sarba rakṣa/ gnod pa thams cad srungs shig ces pa'o/ /sarba mā ra pra mardha ya bdud dpung thams cad rab tu choms/ zhes pa'o/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ /nor 'dzin pa'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ ba su dha ra swā hā/ maṅga bkra shis mdzod cig gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ laṃ ku ru swā hā/ spho ṭa ya bha smiṃ 'di phye mar mdzod/ ces pa'o/ ku ru swā hā/ badzra rdo rje chen po'i zhabs kyis snun/ ces pa'o/ ma hā pā da ya bha smiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bdun tshan gnyis pa'o/ /sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ /sarba pā paṃ pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ chos thams cad rab tu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ sarba dharmā prā ti shuddha ye swā hā/ sarba stambha mnan pa thams cad nges par grol ba'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ ni tā re swā hā/ sarba nā ga bi klu'i dug thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ ces pa'o/ ṣa shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ murtsā rtsod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ pa na ya swā hā/ bhī swa ri swā hā/ */'jigs pa thams cad sel ba'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'o/ oṃ tā re tuttā re sarba siddhi swā hā/ dngos grub thams cad stsol/ ces pa'o/

bdun tshan gsum pa'o// de rnams lha mo nyer gcig so so'i thugs kar bkod pa la yi ge 'bum phrag bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs pas lha so so la rab 'bum phrag bcu/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma'ang 'bum phrag re bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa bya zhing yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o// mchod bstod bya zhing bsngo ba smon lam 'dod don la gsol gdab rnams rgyas par bya'o// nyer bsdu ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo rnams la phog ste/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang 'od gsal du zhugs pa las slar yang rje btsun ma'i skur bzhengs te/ gang snang stong pa bde ba lha sku'i rnam rol du 'char ba la bslab bo// 'di ni bsnyen pa byed tshul bsdus pa ste/ rgyas pa ni jo bo'i rgya gzhung las shes par bya'o// 'di nyid kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa las rung song bas gnas khang du bde bar 'dug cing*/ stan la sogs pa'i steng du maṇḍa lar padma 'dab brgyad nyi shu rtsa gcig bris pa'i lte ba rnams su zla ba'i gdan la rang rang gi mdog can gyi bum pa'am tām̐ yig re bris la/ mthar mchod gtor bzang pos bskor bar bya'o// bum pa nang rdzas mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa rab nyer gcig 'bring bdun/ tha ma rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis kyi mdun du mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon gyis bdag mdun bum gsum bsgrubs la mchod bstod rgyas par byas te lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi gnas gsum las yi ge gsum 'od zer dang bcas pa byon nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsgom pa ni bdag 'jug go /de nas slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams khrus byas/ phyag btsal/ maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// zhes sogs kyis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/

spyi dang bye brag gi chos bshad de kun slong bcos/ khyim pa yin na sngon du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa sbyin/ theg chen thun mong ba'i sdom pa 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa rnams brda sprad de/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar gsum gyis sdom pa sbyin/ gdams pa dngos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ yi dam lha'i sku che ba'i yon tan rnams brjod de dad pa lhag par bskyed du 'jug go /rjes gnang dngos gzhi ni/ bdag mdun gyi lha la sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa brgyud kyi bla mas bskor ba mngon sum du yod par slob ma la brda sprad de gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi rdo rje slob dpon gyis// bdag la rje btsun sgrol ma yi// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob ma rnams yi ge bcu pa'i sngags dang las bum gyi chus bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla bre me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng du skad cig gis myur zhing dpa' bo sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo sogs/ so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs sogs gsol btab la sgom du gzhug bdag mdun gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs rje btsun ma dang bcas pa'i sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad sku'i rje btsun ma sku mdog dkar mo/ oṃ dkar po'am 'khor lo dkar po bdud rtsi dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gang rung nam mkha'i khams gang ba che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba yungs 'bru tsam kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu spyan drangs/

slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha ba babs pa dang*/ bye tshan la char babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag sku yi rdo rje'i rjes gnang thob/ rje btsun ma'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur/ dpral bar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar pos mtshan par mos pa gyis shig ces brjod/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re wa shaṃ ku ru kā ya badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbang bskur/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs thams cad slob ma'i lus la 'jug par gyur cig sku rdo rje'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de bzhin du/ sku'i zhes pa'i gnas su gsung gi zhes pa bcug nas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ bdag mdun gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems nas/ rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad gsung gi rje btsun ma dmar mo/ āḥdang padma dang bdud rtsi dang 'od zer dmar po gang rung nam mkha'i khams gang ba nyi zer gyi rdul lhags pa bzhin du spyan drangs/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi thob pa'i nus pa bzhag gsung rdo rje'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byas/ mgrin par padma'i lte bar āḥdamar pos mtshan par gyur/ snying po'i mjug tu/ wāka badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥswā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbang bskur/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma nas rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs thams cad slob ma'i ngag la 'jug par gyur cig

gsung rdo rje'i dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi don du/ thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems nas/ rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad thugs kyi rje btsun ma sngon mo/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje bdud rtsi 'od zer sngon po rnams gang rung nam mkha'i khams gang ba char chen po babs pa bzhin du spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag thugs rdo rje'i rjes gnang thob/ thugs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byas/ snying gar rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsams la/ snying po'i mjug tu/ tsitta badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis dbang bskur/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma nas/ rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs thams cad slob ma'i yid la 'jug par gyur cig thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur cig ces brjod me tog 'thor/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas lha rnams kyi gnas gsum nas yi ge gsum byon nas slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa brtan par bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod la me tog 'thor/ de nas sngags kyi rjes gnang gi don du/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// bla mas lha la gsol ba gdab/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng thugs ka nas brgyud zhal nas byung ba slob ma'i kha nas zhugs/

snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa g.yas skor du 'khor bar bsams la so so'i sngags rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum bya'o// de ni bgegs kyi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ zhi sogs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi dbang gi lha phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khod nas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste// zhes pa'i tshig dang snying po'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas so so'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bkru ba dang 'thung du 'jug go /de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim par gyur par bsam pa ni brtan byed kyi chu dbang ngo*// maṇḍal dbus kyi rdul tshon nam me tog spyi bor bzhag la lha mo dngos su slob ma'i lus la thim par bsams la/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// yi dam lha srung zhugs nas kyang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/

de ni lha bstims pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ces dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar khas blang*/ rgyun du rje btsun ma yi dam du byed par dam bca'/ yon dang maṇḍal phul/ gtang rag mchod bstod rgyas par bya zhing bsngo ba smon lam/ nyer bsdu bkra shis dga' ston la rol par bya'o// jo bo rje'i thugs dam gyi lha rje btsun ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun bzhin du shākya'i dge slong grub dbang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyis gnas mchog rgyal gyi lha zhol thos bsam gling du sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar bar gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
